query:
-- Check all attendance_weekly rows for April 2025 to see what events are captured
SELECT weekStartDate, campus, subgroup, headcount
FROM attendance_weekly
WHERE weekStartDate BETWEEN '2025-04-13' AND '2025-04-27'
ORDER BY weekStartDate, campus, subgroup;
